instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable files. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Open the provided init.ifc model in Bonsai and use init_plan.png as the plan reference. Modify the existing single-floor apartment so the former bedroom is split into two bedrooms, then save the completed IFC4 model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc using Bonsai's graphical save/export controls. The completed model should keep one project, one site, one building, and one building storey. It should contain exactly five real IfcSpace objects named Living, Kitchen, Bed 1, Bed 2, and Bath. Include at least eight IfcWall elements, at least one IfcDoor element, at least one IfcRelVoidsElement, and at least one IfcRelFillsElement. Do not use IfcBuildingElementProxy or IfcFurniture objects as substitutes for the required BIM elements. Do not create a CSV schedule or separate report file; the room split and required spaces must be represented directly in result.ifc. Other non-required IFC metadata may vary as long as the saved model satisfies these stated GUI-created IFC requirements.
